summary.main_idea: Bosch PowerPoint presentations should use generous, clearly structured layouts with ample white space, default eForms typography settings, and standardized slide types for title, chapter, split/full-picture, and content use cases.
design_intent: Support the Bosch corporate design through generous structure and white space.
Keep typography consistent by relying on eForms defaults.
Use slide types as modular layout patterns for different communication needs.

global.guideline: Bosch presentations should be structured as generously as possible.
global.ai: Prefer clean layouts, avoid overcrowding, preserve generous margins and open space.

global.guideline: Font sizes, line spacing, font styles, and colors are already set in eForms.
global.ai: Use default eForms typography whenever possible instead of manually adjusting fonts, colors, or spacing.

global.guideline: Smaller font sizes may be used only if necessary, while ensuring sufficient legibility.
global.ai: If content density requires smaller text, preserve readability and avoid reducing text below practical viewing size.

navigation_sections: Split screen and full screen slides
taxonomy.note: The overview image grid labels the fourth category as 'Content slides', while the detailed section labels it as 'Standard content slide'.

slide_types.name: Title slides
slide_types.purpose: Used as standard title or cover slides for Bosch PowerPoint presentations.
slide_types.guidance: The following eForms slide templates are the standard title slides: Title slide horizontal; Title slides vertical.
ai: Use the appropriate horizontal or vertical title slide template.
Keep title-slide structure aligned with eForms templates.
Avoid unnecessary content density on title slides.

slide_types.name: Chapter slides
slide_types.purpose: Used to separate or introduce chapters or major sections in a presentation.
slide_types.guidance: The chapter slides are available in both horizontal and vertical designs to match the design of the title slides. The large chapter number is numbered manually.
ai: Match the chapter slide design direction to the title slide design.
Treat the chapter number as a manually controlled content element.
Use chapter slides to create clear narrative segmentation.

slide_types.name: Split screen and full screen slides
slide_types.purpose: Used as flexible layout variants for either content slides or title slides, especially when using photos or images.
slide_types.guidance: These layout variants can be used both as content slides and for title slides. Photos and images used must correspond to the Bosch imagery style.
ai: Use split-screen or full-screen formats when the image is central to the message.
Ensure all photos and images follow Bosch imagery style.
The same layout family may support title or content purposes depending on the slide narrative.

slide_types.name: Standard content slide
slide_types.purpose: Used for regular presentation content such as text, diagrams, images, videos, and Bosch icons.
slide_types.guidance: The fixed components include chapter heading, headline, content area, sender area, footer lines, confidentiality note, and optional attachment note.

components.position_or_role: Area for texts and/or diagrams, images, videos, and Bosch icons
Symbol/logotype and Supergraphic as narrow stripe
Page number, note 'Internal', business unit, date
Confidentiality note; or 2nd line if no filing note is provided
Optional, inserted via the input mask in MasterLayout (ML)

attachment.compliance_reference: The content must comply with the central instruction 'Uniform Form for Internal and external correspondence'.
attachment.if_not_needed: If no attachment note is necessary, the headline can fill this area completely.

ai: Preserve the fixed hierarchy: chapter heading first, headline second, content area below.
Use accent color for the headline line as specified.
Keep sender, Supergraphic, and footer information as structural elements, not decorative extras.
Use the attachment note area only when required.

downloads.description: The download area contains all eForms slide types for external agencies and Mac users in 16:9 format, as well as the related Bosch Office Sans font.
resources_mentioned: All eForms slide types in 16:9 format

related.relationship: Supports typography consistency for PowerPoint slides.
Required for photos and images in split-screen and full-screen slides.
Supports overall slide structure and spacing decisions.

recommended_use: Use this JSON as a rule base for generating or evaluating Bosch-style PowerPoint slides.
Map slide purpose to one of the slide_type ids before selecting a layout.
Apply global presentation guidelines before optimizing any individual slide.
validation_checks: Does the slide use the correct slide type for its purpose?
Is the slide generously structured with sufficient white space?
Are eForms default typography settings preserved?
If smaller fonts are used, is legibility still sufficient?
If imagery is used, does it comply with Bosch imagery style?
For standard content slides, are fixed components preserved?
